subject: Banking
title: Nick Leeson and Barings Bank
description: A quick win: understand Nick Leeson and Barings Bank.

hook.text: Nick Leeson lost $1.4 billion and destroyed Barings Bank in 1995. One trader sank a 233-year-old institution.

buildup.text: Leeson traded derivatives from Barings' Singapore office. He hid losses in a secret account numbered 88888.

discovery.text: Leeson doubled down on losing bets, hoping the market would recover. Each loss led to a bigger bet.

twist.text: Barings had no risk oversight in Singapore. Leeson was both the trader making bets and the manager reporting results.

climax.text: Leeson didn't start as a criminal. He hid one small loss, then another.

punchline.text: One trader. One hidden account. 233 years of banking history, destroyed.

quiz.question: What was the fundamental oversight failure at Barings?
options: Leeson was both the trader and the one reporting his own results
